say:2:1012204001:0.text: How long do we have to stay here with this hornleaf bear? He's too loud. He might attract his friends here...
say:2:1012204001:0.source_cn: 咱还要跟这头叶角熊耗下去吗？它叫得太响了，我怕它会引来...

say:3:1012204002:0.text: What are you scared for?! It's just one hornleaf bear!
say:3:1012204002:0.source_cn: 看你那怂样！区区一只叶角熊你也怕！

say:4:1012204003:0.text: This fella is pretty tough, though. It keeps attacking itself and using the pain to try and keep sane. I love how it struggles.
say:4:1012204003:0.source_cn: 这家伙还挺顽强，它一直在攻击自己，用痛苦维持理智。我就...

say:5:1012204004:0.text: Do we have any more of those <style="highlight">pills</style>? A few more and I think it'll be under our control.

say:6:1012204005:0.text: No more, Boss... You know that there's something going on in Ryeham. There aren't enough Gemvine grapes to go around, and the Syndicate can't provide more pills.
say:6:1012204005:0.source_cn: 没了头儿……你也知道，金穗村那边出了点乱子，藤水晶不够...

say:10:1012204006:0.text: It's the cursed Adamant Syndicate again... What have they been feeding the hornleaf bears?
say:10:1012204006:0.source_cn: 又是可恶的黑金商会……他们给叶角熊吃了什么！

say:13:1012204007:0.text: That hornleaf bear is in pain... Could it be the friend that Hewynn was speaking of?
say:13:1012204007:0.source_cn: 那只叶角熊很痛苦……难道伊温说的朋友，是这只叶角熊吗？

say:14:1012204008:0.text: There was no mistaking it. Hewynn said her friend was gentle and fluffy. That's exactly how you would describe a hornleaf bear!
say:14:1012204008:0.source_cn: 错不了，伊温说他的朋友很温柔，还是个毛绒绒，那不就是平...

say:15:1012204009:0.text: We cannot allow these people to harm the creatures of the forest! Let's move!
say:15:1012204009:0.source_cn: 不能任凭这些人伤害生灵，上吧！
